title.narrative: Netherlands Pavillion at Uganda International Trade Fair

description.narrative: Following a two-year absence due to the outbreak of the Corona pandemic, EKN will set up a Netherlands Pavilion at the Uganda International Trade Fair (UGITF), an annual event organized by the Uganda Manufacturers Association (UMA). This year’s edition will take place from the 3rd to the 10th of October at the UMA Lugogo Show Grounds.The Uganda International Trade Fare (UGITF) is the premier business development and networking event of the country and one of the national calendar events that have grown tremendously over the last 28 editions, attracting more than 1000 manufacturers, traders, and distributors from almost every business sector and with an average of 30,000 show guests daily.This Trade Fair will be organized from the 3rd - 10th of October 2022. It will attract over 350,000 visitors. The theme for the fair is Business Recovery by harnessing local sourcing and deepening value chains integration”. The event will showcase businesses that have demonstrated resilience and ably navigated the minefield of the COVID-19 pandemic to emerge as successful businesses post the COVID-19 pandemic.The Private Sector in Uganda is dominated by small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) that are engaged in various segments of the different value chains where they operate. SMEs in both service provision, production and value addition will participate. In general, the Trade Fair is open to participation from all sectors. The fair highlights market opportunities in Uganda and the East African Community market for local and foreign companies.The main objective of this project is to establish a Netherlands Pavilion that will expand marketing opportunities for Dutch companies and Ugandan companies with a Dutch connection based in Uganda. To achieve this objective, the Netherlands Pavilion will host Matchmaking Sessions and brokerage support services. The goal is to link Ugandan companies to Dutch suppliers, enhance Dutch brand visibility and create a knowledge-sharing link that fosters productive and sustainable trade and investment. The UGITF is a growing network of Dutch and Ugandan companies across various sectors. This platform enables:Dutch and Ugandan companies to showcase and promote their innovative products and services.Identification, development and strengthening of new and existing synergies with other business partners.The Netherlands embassy in Kampala, Uganda, and UMA will assist companies in following up on viable business leads through matchmaking and site visits.Lastly, both EKN and UMA will proactively link companies to the relevant Business Facilitation Agencies such as, among others, the Uganda Revenue Authority, Uganda Export Promotion Board, and Uganda Private Sector Foundation.Participation Profile Dutch Pavilion attendantsThe NL Pavilion will host SMEs across various sectors. The entrepreneurs who will use the exhibition space must have a strong connection to the Netherlands embassy in Kampala, Uganda, or RVO.The fair takes one week so entrepreneurs can share exhibition space.
